proxies.m3: total bilirubin >= 2.0 mg/dL (proxy, requires clinician verification)
proxies.m4: MAP < 65 mmHg on 2 consecutive hourly readings (hypotension proxy; no vasopressor data; requires clinician verification)
proxies.m5: SpO2/FiO2 < 315 (if FiO2 known) else SpO2 < 92%, on 2 consecutive hourly readings (oxygenation proxy; no PaO2 or ventilator data; requires clinician verification)

training_data: PhysioNet/CinC Challenge 2019 (open); training on hospital A, external test on hospital B
disclaimers: Decision support only. Not a diagnosis or treatment recommendation.
Risk values are calibrated model outputs on a proxy label, not validated clinical probabilities.
Relationships are sequence/plausibility only, never causal.
